Built for Ghana's processing ecosystem.
Prototype build · v1.0

Action

Fund the machine. Process the harvest.

ProcessLink Ghana connects equipment funding, operators and agricultural processing customers.

  • Processing, not farming. One machine turns crops into higher-value food for many farmers.
  • Four sides, one flow. Investor, operator, customer and admin in one connected platform.
  • Money you can see. Expenses and the 10% / 40% / 50% split are visible to funders.
  • Built with trust in mind. Hashed passwords, an audit log and tests on the money logic.
  • Honest about its limits. Payments are simulated and no returns are guaranteed.
